This pull request introduces a mechanism to track and clean up detached descendant processes in a sandbox execution environment by snapshotting process identities (PID, PGID, and start token) and verifying them before termination. It also adds a comprehensive test suite to validate nested process group cleanup and PID recycling protection. The review feedback suggests addressing potential unbound variables under `set -u`, optimizing process snapshotting and verification performance (especially on Linux and macOS), and defensively preventing accidental self-termination if the script's own PGID is empty.
